sources.title: Independent affine-map, norm and information-loss derivations
sources.details: y_j=sum_i W[j,i]x_i+b_j; y(0)=b, y(1)=W1+b; difference=-W1. Specified row [1,2,0,0],b=0.5 gives 0.5 and 3.5. Real (1,8) norm is sqrt(sum_j delta_j^2); independently recomputed from all actual FP32 delta elements. If E(red)=E(blue), deterministic P(E(red))=P(E(blue)); fixed question/no distinguishing side input gives same conditional decoder output. Nonidentical logits can share an incorrect argmax (explicit red/blue/green counterexample in a_cpu). W=0 yields exact shared bias and zero recomputed difference. These derivations and conditions are expanded in a_analysis.
